text:
julie-support: FYI - Support ticket C-3482. Multiple customers (high-volume partners) reporting 500s from the Hosted API (/v1/generate) when they hit quota. They expect 429s. Started ~2026-03-14T08:12:xxZ, still happening. Sample customer: org-id=org_7b, api-key=redacted.

ashok-eng: digging in. initial glance shows rate-limiter returning 500 instead of 429. suspecting upstream quota service timeout -> misclassified as 5xx.

kaya-oncall: @ashok-eng can you post a repro curl so support can confirm? also pinging @maria-sre for infra.

ashok-eng: repro below (sanitized):

curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'

-- response (observed):
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
content-type: application/json

{"error":{"message":"quota check failed","code":"internal_error"},"trace_id":"trace:1a2b3c"}

ashok-eng: but we should be returning 429 when quota exceeded. Checking gateway logs.

maria-sre: looking at envoy/gateway logs for trace:1a2b3c. From traces: gateway called rate-limiter -> quota-service, quota-service did a dependency call to quota-db which timed out. Error path mapped to 5xx by gateway config.

ops-bot: Incident alert: quota-service experienced spike of downstream timeouts in eu-west-1 between 08:10-08:25 UTC (threshold breached).

samir-platform: stack trace snippet from quota-service (cut):
2026-03-14T08:13:05Z ERROR quota-service handler: failed to evaluate quota for key=org_7b: err="context deadline exceeded" trace_id=trace:1a2b3c
2026-03-14T08:13:05Z WARN gateway error-mapper: mapping upstream timeout to HTTP 500 for request trace_id=trace:1a2b3c

maria-sre: looks like two things: (1) quota-db nodes had slow queries (median p99 spike) causing quota-service to hit RPC timeout, (2) gateway error-mapper is mapping these timeouts to 5xx instead of returning 4xx/429 to caller when the condition is "quota exceeded". We need to separate the two cases: dependency timeout vs deterministic quota-deny.

julie-support: Customers are upset because their clients see 500s and are retrying, causing more load and double-billing confusion. Support asked for an immediate mitigation and a postmortem.

kaya-oncall: Mitigations proposal:
- Short term (now): flip gateway mapping so quota-service timeout -> return 429 with a special header X-QuotA-Fallback if we can detect quota checks, or at least return 4xx for known quota-deny code paths.
- Immediate rollout: apply an envoy route config patch to map quota-service gRPC deadline_exceeded -> 429 for requests hitting /quota.CheckQuota path.
- Medium term: add circuit-breaker for quota-db and local token-cache fallback so quota-service can answer heuristically when DB is flakey.

ashok-eng: I can push a minimal gateway patch to map deadline_exceeded to 429 in the error_map config. Will run canary to 10% traffic to avoid surprises.

maria-sre: for canary do eu-west-1 only and throttle to partner orgs excluded from default experiment. Run for 20m and monitor 5xx rate and customer complaints.

samir-platform: I've opened a rollback plan if mapping causes regression. rollback steps: revert envoy config via config-manager (run: kubectl -n gateway apply -f envmap-rollback.yaml) and re-route to old mapping.

julie-support: please update ticket C-3482 with the triage and let customers know ETA. Send a short note: we identified quota DB timeouts causing quota-service to error; temporary mapping change planned.

ashok-eng: quick logs from gateway when the problem occurs (sanitized):
[2026-03-14T08:13:05Z] gateway request_id=abc123 upstream=quota-service: deadline_exceeded mapped_status=500 route=/v1/generate peer=10.2.1.45
[2026-03-14T08:13:05Z] quota-service trace_id=trace:1a2b3c callers: rate-limiter->quota-db: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded

maria-sre: Datadog trace: https://app.datadoghq.com/trace/trace:1a2b3c (internal) - shows long latency on quota-db select by user_key with spike at 800ms->1.8s. Database CPU and IO are elevated around that time.

kaya-oncall: immediate action items (assigned):
- @ashok-eng: prepare envoy config patch and canary deploy to eu-west-1. (ETA 25m)
- @maria-sre: watch quota-db metrics and increase DB read replica capacity if necessary. (ETA 15m)
- @samir-platform: prepare rollback manifest and monitor dashboards. (ETA 20m)
- @julie-support: draft customer-facing message and send to impacted accounts after canary is healthy.

julie-support: copy of customer message draft: "We're aware of intermittent 500s on generate endpoints when quota checks occur. We're rolling a hotfix to return 429 for quota conditions and reduce customer impact. ETA ~30m. We'll follow up with postmortem."

ashok-eng: pushing envoy patch now to staging then canary. Patch diff (config snippet):
error_map:
  grpc_deadline_exceeded: 429
  grpc_unavailable: 502
  default_5xx: 500

-- note: this is intentionally narrow to /quota.CheckQuota gRPC method; other upstream timeouts remain 5xx.

ops-bot: Deploy started: config-manager deploy envmap-patch to cluster gateway-eu-west-1-canary (user=ashok-eng)

maria-sre: DB autoscaler triggered a small scale-up of one read-replica (manual) to relieve p99. We'll keep it up for 1hr.

kaya-oncall: canary results at +12m: 5xx from partner orgs dropped by 92%, 429 increased from 0->~1.8% (expected). No new error classes seen. Rolling to 50% now.

samir-platform: monitoring alert: retries from customers decreased. No increase in latency for primary path. rollback not needed.

julie-support: informed customers with update. Some asked for billing credit assessment because retries caused extra token consumption; routing to billing team (billing-bot).

billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-984 - review partner org_7b extra token usage during 08:10-08:30 UTC window.

maria-sre: follow-up action items (postmortem):
- Add explicit error mapping for quota path in gateway (permanent).
- Add local token cache and circuit-breaker for quota-service.
- Improve quota-db alerting (cpu/io anomaly rules).
- Add synthetic tests to hit quota path and ensure mapping correctness.

ashok-eng: I'll open PR for permanent config + tests.

julie-support: thanks team. Closing active incident once rollout to all regions complete and billing review started. :white_check_mark:

kaya-oncall: tagging this thread for postmortem write-up. Assigning owners for each action item.

ops-bot: Incident resolved (partial) - mitigation applied. Follow-ups scheduled.

julie-support: closing note for the thread: root cause = quota-db dependent timeouts => quota-service returned errors that gateway mapped to 500; mitigation = gateway error_map patch + DB replica scaling; next steps = caching/circuit-breaker + permanent mapping + billing review.
